entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Build failures: macOS-13 based runner images are now retired #122709
    8.0.x
  • ComInterfaceGenerator failed to generate source when two base COM interfaces in another assembly have methods of the same name #122708
  • [API Proposal]: Assembly.LoadFrom(myassembly.cs) #122707
  • Feature: more specific exception types from System.Linq.Queryable.Single #122703
  • HostApplicationBuilder in .NET 10 Violates SOLID Principles and Diverges from Established Hosting Semantics for IHostApplicationBuilder interface. #122700
  • Intermittent segmentation fault in System.Security.Cryptography.AesGcm on Fedora 41 with .NET 9 (crash in ossl_aes_gcm_decrypt_avx512) #122697
  • JIT: Redundant bounds check when iterating over many spans with equal length #122696
  • Test failure: Interop/COM/RuntimeAsync/RuntimeAsync/RuntimeAsync.cmd #122694
  • Test failure: _inst_unbox_thunks::InstUnBoxThunks.ManyArgGenericInstantiating() #122692
  • Test failure: async/byref-param/byref-param/byref-param.dll #122691

Closed

  • Vector256<T>.IsSupported should respond to DOTNET_EnableHWIntrinsic=0 #122705
  • SEHException after instantiating invalid ManualResetEvent #12158
  • [RISC-V] Large number of CLR tests failing and significant test count reduction on latest main #122043
    Future
  • Test failure: System.Diagnostics.Tests.StackTraceTests.ToString_ShowILOffset #122690
  • ConfigurationBinder ignores required members #121905
  • 1990 #122693

PullRequests

Created

  • Use QueryInterruptTime instead of GetTickCount64 to allow more responsive Windows apps when they opt-in #122706
    area-System.Threading
  • [wasm][coreclr] Fix struct layout #122704
    arch-wasm, area-TypeSystem-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Update iOS and tvOS device queues to OSX 15 #122702
    area-Infrastructure, os-ios, 11.0.0

Merged

  • Fix up hijacking on x64 platforms in presence of runtime async #122631
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Move managed type system APIs to UTF-8 #122658
    area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Remove implicit string operator from Utf8String #122149
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Add native AOT arm64 CFG testing #122701
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Delete redundant RhpUniversalTransition #122689
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix Native AOT repro project #122695
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix dataflow analysis of lambdas in async methods #122623
    linkable-framework, area-NativeAOT-coreclr

    NO-MERGE, NO-REVIEW, area-NativeAOT-coreclr

    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • arm64: Replace RSH/RSZ -> CAST nodes with clearing register #121007
    arch-arm64, area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [wasm][coreclr] Do not try to probe .ni.dll assemblies #122643
    area-AssemblyLoader-coreclr, Future
  • [browser][coreCLR] exit/abort/logging infra for unit testing #122646
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [System.Net.Sockets.Tests] Make UDP SendTo implicit-bind and AccessDenied tests deterministic on mobile/restricted environments #122556
    area-System.Net.Sockets, os-android, community-contribution
  • Implement ZStandard Stream, Encoder, Decoder #119575
    area-System.IO.Compression, 11.0.0
  • [release/10.0] [mono][interp] Add max limit to the imported IL when inlining #122588

  • Fix Mono Debugger 200ms Pause (Issue #122344) #122449
